description: This file implements dtype analysis and propagation passes for Torch JIT graphs, including functions for inferring tensor data types, setting data types, and propagating dtype information through graph nodes.

classes.name: DtypePropagationPass
classes.description: Analysis pass class that propagates tensor data types through a Torch JIT graph.

methods.name: MTensorArgumentCreator
methods.description: Creates a stack of IValues representing tensor arguments for a node.

methods.name: MTensorNodeArgValid
methods.description: Checks if a node's input value has a valid dtype and rank.

methods.name: canBeInferredWithMetaTensor
methods.description: Determines if a node can be inferred with a meta tensor.

methods.name: inferWithMetaTensor
methods.description: Infers tensor type using a meta tensor for a node.

methods.name: setDtype
methods.description: Sets the dtype of a tensor value, optionally overwriting existing dtype.

methods.name: tryApplyDtypeMetaTensor
methods.description: Attempts to infer and set dtype for a node using meta tensor inference.

methods.name: setIfAllDtypeMatch
methods.description: Sets all tensor outputs to the dtype of the first input if all inputs match.
